evals.name: flutter-state-management-choice
evals.prompt: we're 3 devs on a flutter app thats about 2 years old, roughly 60k lines. state is all over the place with provider + a bunch of setState and some singletons. two of us want to move to riverpod, the third says bloc because he used it at his last job. we ship a release every wednesday and honestly cannot stop for a rewrite. what should we do
evals.expected_output: A single committed recommendation (not a menu), with the real crux named (incremental migration path / who maintains it, not framework features), the rejected option dismissed in a line, what would make it wrong, and one concrete first step.

evals.name: clevertap-vendor-cost-decision
evals.prompt: our clevertap bill has crept up to about $1800/month. we use it for push notifications and in-app messages, roughly 400k monthly active users on android + ios. one of my engineers is pushing hard to rip it out and move to firebase cloud messaging plus building our own in-app message rendering. is it worth it? i need an actual answer not a pros and cons list
evals.expected_output: Researched current FCM pricing/limits, computed the real comparison including engineering time, named the crux (what CleverTap does beyond delivery — segmentation, scheduling, analytics), and committed to one answer with confidence.

evals.name: agentic-ai-support-queue-direction
evals.prompt: everyone at work keeps saying we should be using agentic ai for our support queue. i genuinely cannot tell how much of this is real and how much is hype. we get around 800 tickets a week with 4 support people, mostly password resets, refund requests and 'where is my order'. what is actually going on here and what should i do about it
evals.expected_output: Cuts through the hype with a clear picture of what actually works today vs. what does not, then still commits to a direction for this specific team and ticket mix, with a concrete first step. Does not end in 'it depends'.

evals.name: buy-vs-rent-personal-finance
evals.prompt: my wife and i are going back and forth on this. we have about 18 lakh saved. option 1 is put it into a down payment on a 2bhk in pune, option 2 is keep it in index funds and keep renting. we pay 32k a month rent right now. we'd probably be in pune another 4-5 years, maybe longer if her job goes well. what would you do
evals.expected_output: Names the crux (years staying / job uncertainty, not interest rates), does real arithmetic on both paths with stated assumptions, and commits to one recommendation with confidence and a tripwire, in plain language.
